arabic text: CHAAND SURAJ JISSE KEHTI HAI YE DUNIYA ZEHRA\nASL ME HAI YE TERE NOOR KA SADKA ZEHRA
english translation text: O ZAHRA, WHAT THE WORLD CALLS THE SUN AND MOON\nIN REALITY THEY ARE A TOKEN OF CHARITY FROM YOUR LIGHT (NOOR) ZAHRA

arabic text: AAJ BHI DETI HAI AWAAZ HADISE KUDSI\nTUM NAHIN HOTI TO KUCH BHI NAHIN HOTA ZEHRA
english translation text: HADISE KUDSI IS STILL PROCLAIMING TODAY\nIF YOU DID NOT EXIST THEN NOTHING WOULD EXIST ZAHRA

arabic text: ISS LIYE UMME ABIHA TUMHE ME KEHTE HAI NABI\nTUM NE AAGHOSH ME HASNAIN KO PALA ZEHRA
english translation text: IT IS FOR THIS REASON THAT (OUR) NABI CALLS YOU THE MOTHER TO HER FATHER\nYOU RAISED HASNAIN IN YOUR BOSOM ZAHRA

arabic text: CHAND AZWAAJE PAYAMBAR KO GHATAKTA HAI BOHOT\nTERA SHAUHAR SHABE MERAAJ KA DULHA ZEHRA
english translation text: SOME WIVES OF THE PROPHET TROUBLED HIM A LOT\nYOUR HUSBAND IS THE GROOM OF MERAJ ZAHRA

arabic text: HASHR TAK KYUN NA WO AARAAM SE AARAM KARAY\nTERE QADMON PE HAI ISLAAM KA TAKIYA ZEHRA
english translation text: WHY SHOULD IT (ISLAM) NOT REST TILL TIME ENDS\nWHEN YOUR FEET ARE IT'S (ISLAM'S) PILLOW ZAHRA

arabic text: RAZIQE KAUNO MAKA FAATAHE KHAYBAR HAI MAGAR\nTERE MUTTHIYON ME HAI TERI RIZQ ALI KA ZEHRA
english translation text: THE SUSTAINER OF THE UNIVERSE, IS BUT THE CONQUEROR OF KHAYBAR (ALI A.S)\nBUT IN YOUR HANDS LIES THE SUSTENANCE OF ALI, ZAHRA

arabic text: SURAYE DEHR NE YE BAAT BHI SABIT KARDI\nTERE FAAQE SE BHI HOTA HAI YE FAAQAA ZEHRA
english translation text: SURA-E-DAHR HAS PROVEN\nYOUR SACRIFICE (OF HUNGER) AWAKENS (THE UMMAH

arabic text: EK PAYSHAANIYE HUR HAI TO HAI EK ASHQE AZA\nMILGAYA DONO KO RUMAAL TUMHARA ZEHRA
english translation text: THE FOREHEAD OF HUR AND THE TEARS OF AZADARI\nGAINED THE BLESSING OF YOUR HANDKERCHIEF ZAHRA

arabic text: ILTEJA HAI YE TAKALLUM KI DUA DE DENA\nJABHI MUKHTAR SE SUNNA YE QASIDA ZEHRA
english translation text: THIS IS THE WISH OF TAKALLUM THAT YOU GRANT HIS PRAYERS\nWHENEVER YOU HEAR THIS QASIDA RECITED ZAHRA
